# Baiswar

The Baiswar is a Hindu caste found in the state of Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, India.They are sub clan of Bais Rajput and mainly Divided into Khandit and Bansit. They are considered as a obc in state but General Category in Central list in Madhya Pradesh, and General Category in  Chhattisgarh.
The 2011 Census of India for Uttar Pradesh showed the Baiswar population as 17,920.
